response.sql: WITH race_name_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS avg_driver_count FROM race_name_stats) SELECT AVG(s.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(s.driver_count) AS avg_driver_count, AVG(s.driver_count - o.avg_driver_count) AS avg_excess_count FROM race_name_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.driver_count > o.avg_driver_count
